notes.text: These are two separate name-and-reference attestations.

The linked Yerushalmi gives Ada bar bar Chana; Hyman gives Ada bar Chana. [Heilprin’s Ada entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=244&lang=en) also has the doubled bar. In Eruvin, Rav Acha bar Chana says in the name of Rav Sheshet, a transmission recorded by [Heilprin’s Rav Acha entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=340&lang=en). These notices leave open whether the fathers were the same person.
